prompt: Unseen GitOps platform: design immutable promotion across two environments, classify drift, recover a bad commit and source outage, prevent unsafe pruning, and compare Argo CD with Flux from mechanisms and ownership.
deliverables: Exact repository, commit, artifact, renderer, controller and destination identities.
Argo CD versus Flux mechanism/ownership decision.
Policy, secret and least-privilege credential design.
Resource tracking, managed-field and drift classification.
Ordering, health, timeout, retry, self-heal, suspension and prune design.
Controller, Kubernetes, user and exact cleanup evidence.
evidenceRequirements: Disposable local Git remote, synthetic artifacts and local cluster only.
No public repository, real secret, production or cluster-admin learner.
Evidence tied to UTC, commit, digest, object UID and controller revision.
One rejected hypothesis and one stopped deletion preserved.
Reviewer observes user recovery, cleanup and delayed changed case.
